newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 31.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- February jobless rate increases to three-year high of 3.2 percent.
- South Korea government expected to allow private food aid to North Korea.

- President Kim Young-sam, and U.S. Vice President Al Gore reaffirmed on Saturday that no offical food aid will be given to North Korea in reward for its participation in proposed four-way talks on a permanent Korean peace settlement.
